picks.title: Voi founders' new AI startup Pit has become the latest rising star out of Stockholm
picks.why_it_matters: Serial founders with a successful exit (Voi) raising a $16M seed from a16z signals strong conviction in both the team and the European AI ecosystem—worth tracking for co-investment or competitive landscape mapping.

picks.title: India's first space tech unicorn emerges as Skyroot gears up for orbital launch
picks.why_it_matters: India's private space sector hitting unicorn status with imminent orbital launch validates the market opportunity and could unlock a wave of upstream/downstream space tech startups in the region.

picks.title: China's Moonshot AI raises $2B at $20B valuation as demand for open source AI skyrockets
picks.why_it_matters: Rapid revenue growth ($200M ARR) in open-source AI infrastructure signals a major platform shift—early-stage VCs should look for application-layer startups building on top of these emerging open models.
